causes.name: Probability Calibration and Logit Shift
evidence: E22 Foreground Mean Probability dropped from 0.2039 (E19) to 0.0487 (E22).
E22 Foreground Logit Mean shifted down from -2.5283 to -3.8787.
E22 Max Foreground Probability on validation set dropped from 0.8978 to 0.7438.
Lowering decision threshold from tau=0.50 to tau=0.05 restores validation Dice from 0.089% to 8.441% (95.0x recovery).

causes.name: Severe Foreground Area Suppression / Conservative Background Bias
evidence: Predicted Foreground Prevalence dropped by 29.6x (from 0.010701 to 0.000362) relative to GT prevalence (0.009929).
Ratio of Predicted Prevalence to GT Prevalence collapsed from 1.0778 to 0.0364.
Validation Recall at tau=0.50 collapsed from 16.517% to 0.046% (a 355.2x reduction).

causes.name: Threshold Sensitivity at Fixed tau=0.50
evidence: Fixed tau=0.50 artificially cuts off positive caries lesion logits whose peak sigmoid activations range between 0.10 and 0.45.
At tau=0.05, E22 captures lesion areas with Dice = 8.441%.

causes.name: Genuine Catastrophic Feature Collapse / Representation Loss
evidence: FG/BG Logit Separation remains strictly positive (E19: 3.3947, E22: 1.9613).
The model has NOT forgotten lesion spatial representations; spatial rank order separates caries from background, but the absolute calibration was shifted negative by BCE background dominance.

causes.name: Validation Implementation / Protocol Issue
evidence: Validation pipeline strictly deterministic, verified exact reproduction of training CSV metrics (E19 Dice: 14.705%, E22 Dice: 0.235%).
Zero NaNs, zero Infs, deterministic transforms verified.

decision_support_answers.is_e22_genuinely_worse_than_e19: Partially (E22 has lower peak calibration and higher background bias, but retains discriminatory spatial representations recoverable at lower thresholds)
decision_support_answers.is_evidence_of_training_instability: Low-to-Moderate (BCE foreground imbalance drives logit suppression; training loss is smoothly converging from 0.6443 to 0.6430)
decision_support_answers.should_we_change_anything_right_now: NO (Strict adherence to zero mid-run scientific modification; threshold tuning or focal/pos-weight loss reserved for EXP-002/future experiments)
